value.title: Ember Dutch Oven 5.5qt
value.tagline: Bakes bread at 500°F, braises for eight, and the lid is a skillet.
value.description:
Poured in our Bend foundry and pre-seasoned three times with flaxseed oil, the Ember is the pot you'll reach for at home and at camp. The flanged lid holds coals for top heat, then flips into a 10-inch skillet.

The enamel interior on the Ember red finish cleans up with soap and water; the bare iron finish gets better every time you cook.

poster.name: caldera-dutch-bread-poster.jpg

gallery.caption: Baking a no-knead loaf over coals

image.alt: The lid flipped over and used as a skillet to fry eggs
image.name: caldera-dutch-lid-skillet.jpg

highlights.label: Safe to 650°F and over open fire

value.care: Rinse warm, scrub with the chainmail pad, dry over low heat and wipe a few drops of oil inside. Never soak bare iron or run it through the dishwasher.

policies.title: Shipping
policies.body: Orders over $80 ship free in the contiguous US. Cast iron ships in a recycled-fibre box with no plastic.

policies.body: Cook with it for 60 days. If it isn't for you, send it back for a full refund — seasoning and all.
